name: Vesper
subtitle: Media player for iOS
description: Vesper is a media player written in Swift for iOS. It connects to external services and add-ons to display, stream and download content.

apps.name: Vesper
apps.subtitle: Media player for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Vesper connects to Stremio add-ons and your own Usenet provider to browse, stream and download content, with widgets, a built-in player and iCloud sync for your library and add-ons. Requires iOS 27 or later.
apps.versionDescription: Introduced widgets, a new app icon, cleaned up API entry pages, iCloud sync for your library and add-ons, and various UI refinements.
